title: alcea lavateriflora var. kirrindensis
intro: Alcea lavateriflora var. kirrindensis, commonly known as the Himalayan hollyhock, is a plant species belonging to the mallow family (Malvaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alcea lavateriflora var. kirrindensis include its ability to modulate immune response, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
